Copper divider animation (tw-divider) for section separators with wave effect
Progress bar at bottom shows amber fill based on current page position with 300ms ease-out transition

context_for_next_testing_agent: TIDE WAR is a NEW 26-page cinematic presentation with ocean/nautical design language. Routes: /proposals/preview/tide-war (no auth, direct access), /proposals/tide-war (email gate). All data hardcoded in TideWarPresentation.jsx. Features: Deep ocean black #04080F background, amber-gold #D4860A primary accent, copper-bronze #8B5E2A secondary, sea-glass white #E8F0EC body text. Wide-tracked Oswald uppercase headings, Libre Baskerville serif body. Current sweep page transitions (amber line sweeping left-to-right), horizontal amber current-line particles. Closure Clock element on pages after page 3 showing weeks countdown. Page 18 (SABLE FONTAINE villain) switches to cold institutional color scheme (#070C12 coldBg, #8A9BAA coldSilver) with stopwatch '71:02:17'. 17 character/content images + 1 video. CSS-only animations via data-active attribute and animation classes (adl/adr=drift, af=fadeIn, au=fadeUp, ar=riseUp, adi=dropIn, arv=reveal, abr=bright, aap=appear), full keyboard/touch navigation, progress bar at bottom. Video on page 25: tidewar-video.mp4.
